question.problem: Given an arithmetic sequence that has $f(11)=78$ and common difference $d=4$, what is the index of the term $50?$
question.worked_solution:
Since $f(11)=78$ is $10$ jumps after $f(1),$ we can determine the first term of the sequence:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(11) & =f(1)+10d \\ 78 & =f(1)+10(4) \\ 78 & =f(1)+40 \\ 38 & =f(1)\end{aligned}
$$

So, the formula for the $n$th term is:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(n) & =f(1)+(n-1)d \\  & =38+(n-1)(4) \\  & =38+4n-4 \\  & =4n+34\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we solve for the value of $n$ that gives $f(n)=50,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(n) & =4n+34 \\ 50 & =4n+34 \\ 16 & =4n \\ \frac{16}{4} & =n \\ 4 & =n\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $50$ is the $4$th term of the sequence.
